description: This file defines the ReadableCategory class, which extends CategoryEntity and implements Serializable. It encapsulates category details such as description, parent category, and product count within a shopping or catalog system.

classes.name: ReadableCategory
classes.description: A class representing a readable category with description, parent, and product count.

methods.name: getProductCount
methods.description: Gets the number of products in the category.

methods.name: setProductCount
methods.description: Sets the product count for the category.
